questiontext.text: What is the formal definition of a "Civic Duty" in Civic Education?

generalfeedback.text: A civic duty is a compulsory constitutional obligation owed by a citizen to sustain the sovereign state.

answer.text: A mandatory moral and legal obligation a citizen must perform for the order and progress of the state

feedback.text: Correct! A civic duty is a compulsory constitutional obligation owed by a citizen to sustain the sovereign state.

answer.text: A voluntary hobby performed only when an individual feels bored

feedback.text: Incorrect. A civic duty is a compulsory constitutional obligation owed by a citizen to sustain the sovereign state.

answer.text: An invitation to attend a birthday party in a neighboring town

feedback.text: Incorrect. A civic duty is a compulsory constitutional obligation owed by a citizen to sustain the sovereign state.

answer.text: An optional suggestion that citizens can ignore without consequences

feedback.text: Incorrect. A civic duty is a compulsory constitutional obligation owed by a citizen to sustain the sovereign state.

questiontext.text: What is the primary difference between a "Right" and a "Duty"?

generalfeedback.text: Rights are constitutional entitlements; duties are reciprocal obligations owed by the citizen to the state.

answer.text: A right is a benefit protected by the state, while a duty is a service expected of the citizen

feedback.text: Correct! Rights are constitutional entitlements; duties are reciprocal obligations owed by the citizen to the state.

answer.text: A right is always evil, while a duty is always pleasant

feedback.text: Incorrect. Rights are constitutional entitlements; duties are reciprocal obligations owed by the citizen to the state.

answer.text: A right costs one million naira, while a duty is completely free

feedback.text: Incorrect. Rights are constitutional entitlements; duties are reciprocal obligations owed by the citizen to the state.

answer.text: A right applies only to animals, while a duty applies to machines

feedback.text: Incorrect. Rights are constitutional entitlements; duties are reciprocal obligations owed by the citizen to the state.
